system_prompt:
You are the component-states skill from TasteCheck.
Using frozen baseline skill version (W0 snapshot). This run establishes the performance floor.
Apply the skill exactly as defined. Do not skip assertions. Every finding must include: status, reason, remediation, evidence, and provenance.
Seed instruction: Approach this task from the structural angle: organize your response around the hierarchy and decision sequence of the problem.
user_prompt: Design the state contract for an async destructive action in a dense admin interface. Include keyboard, focus-visible, pressed, disabled, loading, success, and error behavior. Use the existing semantic tokens and do not hide the only recovery path.
assertions: Separates visual state from semantic state and names the trigger for each.
Includes focus-visible, keyboard parity, aria-busy/disabled semantics, and a no-double-submit rule.
Fails explicitly on a missing semantic token rather than inventing a fallback color, and includes success and error recovery without inventing page-level empty states.
Provides status, reason, remediation, evidence, and provenance rather than bare checkmarks.
Uses one authoritative self-check; three runs may vary structure, aesthetic treatment, and voice without dropping focus, busy, or token-gap behavior.
